title: Normalization and denormalization
objectives: A normalized model stores each repeating fact in its own relation. Contacts and email addresses have different cardinalities: one contact can own zero, one, or many addresses.
The child table has one address per row, a foreign key to its owner, and a compound primary key that rejects a duplicate address for the same person.
securityBoundary: Normalization is a logical data-integrity decision, not a performance guarantee. Denormalized read models must have an explicit refresh and reconciliation strategy.
